title: Add Plugins tool for Claude Code marketplaces
body:
This change adds support for scanning and managing skills, commands, and agents found in the Claude Code marketplace directory (`~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces`). It introduces a new 'Plugins' tool entry with a dedicated 'plug' icon and implements a recursive scanning pattern specifically for marketplace structures.
